requirementCoverage.evidence: artifact/invitation-copy.ts and .css: reusable native custom element, exact English label and required invitation URL; real clipboard check passed.
keyboard-target-pending: disabled button plus internal guard produced exactly one clipboard request despite a dispatched duplicate click.
success-reset: Link copied label and status restored to original after measured 2056ms.
reject-retry-enter and unavailable-and-translation: useful inline alert, enabled retry, and successful next request.

unavailable-and-translation and german-320.png: German label fits with wrapping, button 242 by 71 CSS px, document width 320, no clipped scroll content.
artifact/index.html runs directly from file with bundled generated JS. README.md gives reuse and rebuild instructions. Default and narrow screenshots visually reviewed.

assumptions: Requirement IDs are mapped in task-sentence order because descriptions for each individual ID were not supplied.
The translated resting-label check does not require localization of all status/error copy.
Modern browser with custom elements support; clipboard availability remains browser-controlled.
decisions: Use a small native custom element with scoped plain CSS class names and no dependencies, icons, or framework.
Ship compiled JavaScript so opening index.html is sufficient and no network service is needed.
Disable the native button during pending requests and restore keyboard focus if disabling moved it to the document.
Keep persistent live-region elements and clear inline errors on retry.

checks.evidence: evidence/build.stdout.txt: strict TypeScript check and generated JavaScript passed. Initial TypeScript 6 module=None deprecation preserved in evidence/build.first-attempt.stdout.txt; changed output module setting to ES2020.
Inspected evidence/default.png and evidence/german-320.png: restrained card/button styling, legible wrapped German text, and visible focus ring.
Browser DOM verifies status and alert roles and aria-busy. No screen reader session was run.

limitations: Screen reader announcements were not tested with assistive technology; DOM semantics were checked.
Browser verification used installed headless Chrome only; no cross-browser or mobile-device run.
Native clipboard check used browser-granted clipboard permissions; denied and missing APIs were tested with controlled mocks.
Configuration attributes should be set before attaching the custom element; dynamic label attribute changes do not immediately update the resting button.
Initial failed build and failed keyboard run are retained under evidence; final rerun passed.
No token or cost telemetry was exposed. No package installs or network services were used.
